summary: Six ways to get into the Sagrada Familia, from a self-guided ticket with an audio guide to tower access, a short hosted introduction or a full guided tour.
body:
## One building, six ways in

The real decision on this listing is not whether to go, it is which kind of visit to book. Klook groups six options under three headings, and the differences are about guidance, tower access and how flexible the cancellation is.

## Self-guided with an audio guide

Three tickets let you walk in on your own and stay as long as you like, with an audio guide offered in 19 languages:

- **Standard entry ticket** with the audio guide. Free cancellation up to 48 hours before.
- **Passion Tower access** added to the same ticket. Free cancellation up to 72 hours before.
- **Nativity Tower access** added instead. Free cancellation up to 48 hours before.

Pick one tower or the other; they are sold as separate options.

## A short introduction, then your own pace

**Hosted entry** is a skip-the-line ticket where an official English-speaking host meets you, gives a brief introduction to the building, and then leaves you with unlimited free time. It sits between self-guided entry and a full tour. Free cancellation applies up to 7 days before.

## Full guided tours

Both guided options include a skip-the-line ticket, an official English-speaking guide and unlimited free time afterwards:

- **Golden Hour English Guided Tour**, which also includes 10% off at the ArtGaudi souvenir store. Free cancellation up to 7 days before.
- **English Guided Tour**, with free cancellation up to 24 hours before.

## How long to allow

The suggested duration on the listing is one to two hours. Tickets are valid on the date you select, so choose the date before you pay.

## Choosing between them

If you prefer to read or listen at your own speed, the audio-guide tickets are the simplest. If you want the building explained but not a full tour, hosted entry is the middle route. If you want the architecture and symbolism interpreted throughout, take a guided tour. If you want to go up a tower, the Passion and Nativity options are the ones that include it. Note that cancellation windows differ between options, from 24 hours to 7 days, so check the one you are buying.

## Booking basics

Confirmation is instant, and prices change with the date, so compare dates on the booking page.
